title: Report: Internal investigation of Dianna Russini is still "a few weeks" away from conclusion

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Internal investigation of Dianna Russini is still "a few weeks" away from conclusion
sources.description: It's been more than two months since the story of the offseason landed out of the blue, courtesy of photos from the New York Post and (more importantly) clear and strong denials from the people involved.
